_comment: All tunable constants live here, never hardcoded in scripts. Loaded once at startup. This is the one habit worth keeping from day one — when you want to retune the game later, you edit data, not code.

hex._comment: size = distance from a hex's center to any of its corners, in pixels. Orientation is 'pointy-top' (a corner points up). grid_radius = how many rings of hexes around the center hex (radius 4 = 61 hexes).

colors._comment: Hex RGBA colors as 0-1 floats, the format Godot's Color() expects.
